concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑001 (reduction in RMSE between GNN and the graph‑derived Random Forest baseline) is not addressed by any task. No task computes or records the RMSE difference, so the criterion cannot be evaluated.

The `results.schema.yaml` does not define the fields `cohen_d`, `ci_lower`, and `ci_upper` that task T025 (paired t‑test) intends to write. This contract mismatch means the generated results JSON will fail schema validation.

The `bias_check` object in the results schema requires `correlation_coefficient` and `is_confounded`, but no task populates these fields. Task T016 only sets `bias_warning`, leaving the required fields empty.
